title: Front Desk Operating Standard: Arrival, Check-In and Completion of In-Person Appointments
content:
**Arrival.** Patients with In-Person Appointments are asked to arrive the visit type's arrive-early minutes before the start. Where the visit type offers e-check-in, the patient may complete MyLinden e-check-in from the visit type's opening point in hours before the start.

**Intake forms.** A New Patient Office Visit, Annual Preventive Exam, Specialist Consultation, In-Office Procedure Visit or Advanced Imaging Appointment whose intake forms are due the visit type's forms deadline in hours before the start may still be checked in if the forms are completed on arrival.

**Late arrival.** A patient arriving up to the visit type's late-arrival grace in minutes after the start is seen normally. One arriving later but within the visit type's late-arrival limit is checked in and seen if the clinician can accommodate, and otherwise is offered the next slot the same day. Beyond the limit the visit is cancelled as a late arrival under the cancellation terms.

**Clinician running behind.** A checked-in patient whose clinician is running more than the visit type's clinician-delay figure in minutes behind may leave and rebook with no fee and no count; this is recorded as a clinic-initiated cancellation.

**Collection at check-in.** The copay or time-of-service estimate is collected at check-in under the financial account rules. The copay collected at check-in is the one named by the visit type's copay class.

**Completion.** The clinician closes the encounter and the visit is complete. On completion, a visit booked against a referral or authorization uses one unit of it, a held deposit is applied to the visit, and the after-visit summary is posted within the visit type's summary period in hours.

### Status path of a visit at the desk

| From | To | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Booked | Checked in | An unconfirmed patient arrives inside the late-arrival limit and is checked in by the front desk or kiosk |
| Confirmed | Checked in | A confirmed patient arrives inside the late-arrival limit and is checked in |
| Checked in | Completed | The clinician closes the encounter |

### Arrival bands (hypothetical minutes after the start)

| Visit type (grace, limit) | Arrives 8 minutes late | Arrives 18 minutes late | Arrives 25 minutes late |
|---|---|---|---|
| Specialist Consultation (15, 20) | Seen normally | Checked in and seen if the clinician can accommodate, otherwise offered the next slot the same day | Cancelled as a late arrival |
| Established Patient Office Visit (10, 15) | Seen normally | Cancelled as a late arrival | Cancelled as a late arrival |
